title: Daily sales by product
summary: Daily units sold and revenue in euros per product per day, extracted from the till system. Covers 2022-01-01 to present (daily refresh). Contains ~64 products and ~310k rows. A till migration gap from 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 means no rows exist for those days (not zero sales). Product codes changed on 2024-04-01 (codes ending in L replaced), with no mapping table between old and new codes — matching can only be done via product name, which is not always unique. The product list (sales.products) only contains current codes. This source matches need N1 (daily ice-cream sales by product) for both windows.

fields.name: product_code
fields.description: Product code, see the product list. Codes changed 2024-04-01; codes ending in L were replaced. No mapping exists.

spatial.notes: Location is not a column in this table; the Valdena Gelato Shop operates in northern Italy (IT). No explicit geography column.

documentation_excerpts: Catalog: 'Units sold and revenue per product per day, from the till system.'
Wiki (till_migration_2024): 'The till system was replaced between 2024-02-05 and 2024-03-10. No sales were recorded in that period. Treat those days as missing, not as zero sales.'
Wiki (product_codes_2024): 'From 2024-04-01, product codes changed. Codes ending in L were replaced by new codes. No mapping table exists between the old and new codes.'
quality_notes: Till migration gap 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10: no rows exist for those days. Confirmed by wiki till_migration_2024 (last edited 2024-03-12). Treat as missing, not zero sales.

Product codes changed 2024-04-01. Codes ending in L replaced. No mapping table exists. Per wiki product_codes_2024 (last edited 2024-04-02), old and new codes can only be matched by product name, but some product names are not unique. The product list (sales.products) only contains current (post-change) codes.
Catalog states 310k rows approx, last refreshed 2026-10-14. This is after the use case's as-of date (2026-10-15) so data should be up to date for the recent window.
